title: Turn off Solicited Remote Assistance
description: Sets the documented group policy value fAllowToGetHelp to 0 under HKLM SYSTEM CurrentControlSet Control Remote Assistance. Users can no longer invite a helper over Remote Assistance (ms-raf links and HelpAssistant stay off). Help desk scenarios that rely on solicited assistance should not apply this feature. The previous value and its type are captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo.
